    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    d = int(input[1])
    heights = list(map(int, input[2:]))

    dp = [1] * n
    prev = [-1] * n
    max_length = 1
    last_index = 0

    for i in range(1, n):
        left = 0
        right = i - 1
        while left <= right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            if abs(heights[i] - heights[mid]) >= d:
                if dp[mid] + 1 > dp[i]:
                    dp[i] = dp[mid] + 1
                    prev[i] = mid
                left = mid + 1
            else:
                right = mid - 1

        if dp[i] > max_length:
            max_length = dp[i]
            last_index = i

    path = []
    while last_index != -1:
        path.append(last_index)
        last_index = prev[last_index]

    path.reverse()

    print(max_length)
    print(" ".join(map(str, [x + 1 for x in path])))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
